facts.value: Community is a term we apply to a pioneer settlement, e.g., a village, a city, a tribe or a nation. Whenever the members of any group (small or large) live together in such a way that they share the basic conditions of common life, we call that group a community.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: In general, a community is a group of people living in a particular area and having a feeling of common living and identity.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Community is a social group with some degree of we-feeling living in a given area.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: A community is a group or collection of groups that inhibit a locality.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: A community is an area of social living marked by some degree of social coherence.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy
